```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.IESpace eSpace) => {
    
    /*** creating IClientAction 'ToggleMenu' ***/
    var toggleMenu = eSpace.CreateClientAction("ToggleMenu");
    toggleMenu.Description = "ToggleMenu (synthetic)";
    toggleMenu.Public = false; // default value
    
    var startNode = toggleMenu.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    var assignNode = toggleMenu.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IAssignNode>();
    var assignment = assignNode.CreateAssignment("MenuOpen", "not MenuOpen");
    startNode.Target = assignNode;
    var endNode = toggleMenu.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    assignNode.Target = endNode;
}
```
